name: Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi
short_description: A half marathon and multi-distance race held at Kung Wiman Beach, Chanthaburi, Thailand on June 7, 2026.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi is a road race scheduled for June 7, 2026, taking place at Kung Wiman Beach in Chanthaburi, Thailand. Organized by the Scenic Marathon Series, the event offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, catering to a range of runners from casual participants to half marathon finishers. Registration details have not yet been announced.
